{{Quote|This is a Republic military outpost, sovereign territory of the Galactic Republic. We will defend ourselves with deadly force if necessary.|Commander Yajak|<ref name="TOR" />}}
'''Yajak''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] who was stationed on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] as part of the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]], where he commanded [[Border assault post|Waypoint Station Morne]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].

==Biography==
By the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Yajak had rose to the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the Republic military. Brave and fiercly loyal to the Republic, Commander Yajak was in charge of [[Border assault post|Waypoint Station Morne]] on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. As Morne was one of the more distant of the [[Taris Resettlement Initiative]]'s outposts, Yajak and his men were prepared to defend their base at any time from [[rakghoul]]s, [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and [[Scavenger/Legends|scavengers]].

During the Cold War, Morne relied on a monthly convoy from [[Bomber command post|Waypoint Station Draay]] to the west for supplies. But one month, the members of Morne's supply convoy deserted on their way back from Draay, leaving Morne without supplies for that month.

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Draay's [[Quartermaster/Legends|Quartermaster]] [[Kahrin Wek]] grew concerned when they had not heard of the convoy's successful arrival at Morne. She asked a traveling hero, whom had helped her previously to expose Draay's commander [[Gardit]]'s corruption, to investigate. The hero reset the sonic emitters along the path to Morne, clearing the way of rakghouls, [[Nexu/Legends|nexu]], and other wild animals.

The hero encountered [[Gilroh]], [[Geozel]], [[Ferdoin]], and the other members of the convoy not far from Morne. Gilroh attempted to lie and say that they had stopped because of injury, but finally told the truth&mdash;they were deserting. The hero allowed them to flee, as they had served five years on a one year assignment, and told them that the hero wouldn't report them. The hero informed Commander Yajak that they had found the troopers' bodies, enabling the members of the convoy to escape without a problem. Yajak told the hero that he would send home their uniforms to their families, but thanked the hero for their help.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Yajak appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', as the final part of the Taris mission "AWOL". The player character can choose to report the deserters to Yajak instead of letting them go free.
